intro: Our Adria study table is built for focus, comfort, and calm. With a spacious top, smooth hardware, and a subtle design, it creates a work zone that works for you—day in, day out.

features.title: Space to think freely
features.text: With a generous 1200mm-wide surface, we give you the breathing room to work, study, or create without clutter or compromise.

features.title: We protect what matters
features.text: Our design is made with high-grade 18mm prelaminated particle board, finished with melamine to resist moisture and keep your essentials safe.

features.title: Room to move, space to think
features.text: Our open leg space design gives you full freedom of movement, helping you stay focused without feeling boxed in.

features.title: Moves with your life
features.text: With knockdown construction, our study table is easy to transport and assemble—supporting you through every move and milestone.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
